focused_risks: Request-supplied routing/endpoint SSRF can exfiltrate provider credentials.
Proxy config, MCP stdio, code guardrails and OIDC files create unnecessary attack surface for a simple backend adapter.
A trusted Git source tag does not by itself prove the distribution wheel matches it; hashes bind bytes, not safety.
adoption_gates: Inspect exact wheel/source/dependency artifacts without executing them and compare provenance/attestations; reject known compromised releases.
Run any future import/contract test in an isolated no-secret environment with reviewed dependency lock and restricted network.
Keep full home/cloud credentials, global environment and host filesystem out of the worker.
Pass only the authorized per-request key from a server-owned secret reference; disable unrelated callback/logging/plugin surfaces.
Deny caller-supplied arbitrary endpoints, SDK kwargs, code, file references, proxy admin and MCP execution.
